title: Sources of the library and of the architect's rules
status: Read through web-search summaries from 02-10-2026 to 04-10-2026. The pages themselves could not be opened from the session, so every value is as reported and not yet checked against its page (D-UX-18). A value is checked when someone opens the page, reads the figure and sets checked on the source.

classes.4: A cost guide's range: a blog, a calculator or a guide
classes.R: A standard, a code or a law, for a rule rather than a rate
